name: CCW-Online ERP
description: Equipment Supplier ERP - Full-stack Python FastAPI + Next.js

verify.prompt:
Run verification:
1. Check backend is running: curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/
2. Verify database indexes: python verify_indexes.py
3. Run error handling tests: pytest tests/test_error_handling.py -v
4. Check connection pool config in src/config/database.py

audit.description: Audit API performance and test results
audit.prompt:
Review:
1. Check test results in tests/load/reports/
2. Review uvicorn logs for errors
3. Check database query performance
4. Verify all endpoints return JSON

bootstrap.prompt: This CCW-Online ERP project is already set up. Phase 1 and Phase 2.1-2.2 complete.

new-feature.description: Not applicable to this Python FastAPI project
new-feature.prompt: This command is for Node.js projects. For Python FastAPI features, follow the CLAUDE.md guide.

architecture.description: Monorepo with FastAPI backend + Next.js frontend
prohibited: DO NOT upgrade major framework versions without approval
DO NOT use --reload flag for uvicorn (causes crashes)

testing: Always run: pnpm turbo run type-check lint test before marking complete
Phase changes require smoke test verification
Backend restarts must be WITHOUT --reload for stability
